# AI assistant and ChatGPT Subscription

## Architecture rules

- **AI** ([details](../../docs/project/tech-stack.md#ai-features)): only the AI assistant, AI translation, AI subtitles and Meaning in this sentence use the user's own key. Never add a project server or shared key. Keys stay Keystore-encrypted and out of backups; subtitle, file, error and search text goes to the model as quoted data; the assistant acts only through the fixed tools in `assistant/AiActions.kt`, and its own settings, keys and saved words need Full access.

## Fork architecture rules

- **ChatGPT Subscription** (`chatgpt/`): only OpenAI's official Sign in with ChatGPT plan-usage preview with the documented `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/auth/callback` loopback listener (raw socket, never global cleartext). Never use ChatGPT's website, cookies, `backend-api` or any undocumented endpoint, never add a project client secret, and never fall back from it to a keyed service: a missing or failing session means Google or the device. `AiWireFormat.CHATGPT_RESPONSES` goes only through `ChatGptChatTransport` (`AiTransportRouter`). The assistant cannot connect, change or read it. Claude and Gemini work only through API keys.

- **AI connections**: all keys, the ChatGPT sign-in, models and Thinking live in Settings → AI Assistant (`assistant/AiConnection.kt`); the Chat AI Service row and the Translation AI Service row (`ai_translation_provider`) are two independent assignments. Upstream's separate "AI thinking for translation" setting is intentionally not adopted: the per-service Thinking level covers it.

## Full text: docs/project/tech-stack.md, section 'AI features'

### AI features

- The AI assistant (`assistant/`, `ui/AiAssistant*.kt`, owner decision 2026-10-08), the opt-in Translate with AI, AI subtitles for videos without captions (owner pick 2026-11-08, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-08-ai-subtitles-for-videos-without-captions.md): a tap on the no-captions card sends only the video's YouTube address to Gemini with the assistant's Gemini keys, in 5-minute parts, kept in `cacheDir/ai-subtitles/`; no on-device speech model and no audio capture) and Settings → Word learning → Meaning in this sentence (AI) (owner picks 2026-11-10, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-11-10-anki-card-picture-and-front.md): off by default even with a key; each tapped word sends only that word and its sentence, and the card shows the answer above the dictionary meaning and saves "in sentence (dictionary)"; `ui/WordMeaningInContext.kt`) are the only features that use the user's own API key, for Gemini, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Claude (Anthropic's own Messages API), OpenCode Zen/Go, or an OpenAI-compatible HTTPS address. It is on by default, sends nothing until a key is added and a question asked, and Settings → AI assistant turns it off completely (the translation problem icon then returns). Keys are AES-GCM encrypted with an Android Keystore key in `ai_assistant_keys` preferences; keys, `files/ai-chats/` and `files/ai-memory/` (memories and the user's instructions) stay excluded from backups (`BackupRulesTest`). Chats are kept 7 days by default (Off / 7 / 30 days / Forever). Subtitle and error text, and attached text files, go to the model as quoted data; attached pictures and files stay in memory and are never written to chat history. Never add a project server or shared key. The assistant acts only through the fixed tool list in `assistant/AiActions.kt` (owner decision 2026-10-08): small setting changes, playback, speed and Save to vocabulary run at once with an Undo chip; YouTube search, opening a link the user typed, translation changes, and the settings that reload subtitles, download models or change the interface language (`AiSetting.asks`) wait for the user's tap, and so do setting changes after subtitles, files or error text were read. It reads and may change every setting on the settings page except the ones below ([settings spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-16-translation-position-and-ai-settings.md)). Memory changes only through `save_memory` and `forget_memory`, offered only while memory is on for the chat; they run at once with Undo and Manage, except after other text, and never come from subtitles, files or error text (owner decision 2026-10-08, [memory spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-08-ai-assistant-memory.md)). Without full access it can never touch keys, the AI settings, saved words, dragged positions, or Reset all settings. Settings → AI assistant → Permissions → Full access (off by default, owner request 2026-10-18) offers the `AI_FULL_ACCESS_TOOLS`: its own AI settings, adding a key the user typed, removing a key, finding, editing and deleting saved words, and resetting settings or subtitle positions; most run at once with Undo, removing a key and resetting always wait for a tap, and after subtitles, files, error text or saved words were read every change waits for a tap. Only tools offered with the question run. It never touches language downloads, the assistant switch or full access itself. Each service keeps up to 10 keys (`AiKeyStore`, the first under the old one-key names); a rejected, out-of-credit or rate-limited key hands the same request to the next key ([redesign spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-18-ai-settings-redesign-keys-and-full-access.md)). Search and screen (owner decision 2026-10-18, [spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-18-ai-web-search-and-screen.md)): `find_youtube_videos` searches YouTube's own web search (`data/YouTubeVideoSearch.kt`, free, no key, on by default) and only videos it found or links the user typed can be opened, each still waiting for the Open tap; web search (off by default) is the service's own (Claude `web_search`, OpenRouter's server tool, OpenAI's search model; paid to that service) or Tavily with the user's free key (`AiSearchKeyStore`, sealed like the AI keys in `ai_assistant_keys`); `look_at_screen` (on by default) copies the app window with the panel hidden and sends the picture once, never saved. Search results and screenshots are quoted data and count as other text, so later changes wait for a tap. See the [AI assistant spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-08-ai-assistant-panel.md), the [actions spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-08-ai-assistant-actions.md), and the [Claude and Gemini default spec](../../docs/specs/2026-10-11-gemini-flash-lite-default-and-claude.md).
